Der Amadeus Meeting Place Finder, die Lösung zur automatisierten Bestimmung kostengünstiger Veranstaltungsorte, erhält eine ganze Reihe von Verbesserungen. Sie ermöglichen noch präzisere Möglichkeiten, Flug-, Hotel- und sonstige Kosten für Firmenveranstaltungen zu bestimmen und zu steuern.

Zum einen hat Amadeus Germany die Suchmöglichkeiten verfeinert. So lassen sich ab sofort nicht nur Airline-Allianzen, sondern auch einzelne Fluggesellschaften explizit in die Suche aufnehmen oder von ihr ausschließen. Auch lassen sich gezielt Tarife ohne Beschränkungen abrufen, dabei geht es zum Beispiel um Vorausbuchungsfristen, Storno- und Umbuchungsentgelte oder die Erstattbarkeit von Tickets. 

Gleichzeitig unterstützt die Lösung Veranstaltungsplaner jetzt besser dabei, zwischen Reisedauer und Reisekosten abzuwägen: Im Vergleich zur kürzesten Verbindung darf die günstigste Verbindung während der ersten Abfrage maximal 20 Prozent mehr Reisezeit aufweisen, während einer zweiten Abfrage maximal 50 Prozent. Findet der Amadeus Meeting Place Finder keine Direkt-Verbindung, sucht er sofort – mit der gleichen Vorgabe der maximalen Reisezeit – nach Umsteigeverbindungen.

Die Anzeige der gefundenen Angebote schließlich umfasst mehr Details: So zeigt die Lösung jetzt für jede Verbindung die Zahl der Umstiege sowie die Namen der Fluggesellschaften. Zudem wurde das Design des Amadeus Meeting Place Finders übersichtlicher gestaltet.

„Für die Organisation erfolgreicher Events ist viel mehr als nur der Preis wichtig. Der Erfolg ist umso größer, je ausgeruhter die Teilnehmer ankommen, je stärker also der Komfort der Reisenden berücksichtigt wird“, sagt Peter Tomes, Head of Provider and Corporate Solutions von Amadeus Germany. „Daher haben wir die Stellschrauben verfeinert, mit denen Event-Manager die Reisezeit und die Zahl der Umstiege im Blick behalten und steuern können – auch, indem sie zum Beispiel gezielt Tarife ohne Restriktionen suchen.“

Der Amadeus Meeting Place Finder ist als Einzellösung erhältlich wie auch als Teil der Amadeus Event Management Suite. Sie besteht aus den beiden Modulen Amadeus Meeting Place Finder und Amadeus Event Manager (für die Abwicklung aller Prozesse einer Veranstaltung).

MarketTree.co.uk is the new web site for buying and selling goods and services between individuals and/or businesses by fixed-price and auction transactions.

Our mission is to be the UK’s best electronic exchange for buying and selling goods and services by providing an effective, low-cost, simple-to-use marketplace for consumers, individual traders, and businesses.

The company’s service provides an alternative marketplace for those suffering from EBay’s high charges and the fear of de-registration without adequate explanation.

David and Goliath
What hope can a new challenger have against the established giant? Our new, nimble upstart offers innovations to improve both buyers’ and sellers’ experience of on-line trading which differentiate us from EBay.

Our main innovations are:

  • a “no surprises” pricing policy (so that all prices for delivered items include the cheapest delivery cost)

  • auctions that finish 24 hours after the latest bid (there is no pre-determined cut-off time, so no need to delay bidding until the auction is about to finish)

  • much lower fees

  • a recruitment scheme that encourages users to recruit new users by giving them a share of the fees that their recruits generate.

You might care to take a look at our web site – or even try us out for buying, selling or recruiting.

Tipspot started from a simple question: “Why oh why isn’t there a simple overview of what’s happening in town, based on the interests of me and my friends?”

Sure, all major cities and niches have their own websites and magazines with all kinds of event listings. But we were looking for one unified, complete and independent overview. Above all, an overview that is ‘smart’; which respects your interests and keeps you in the loop of what your friends recommend.

It became clear that this didn’t exist yet and that there was only one solution: build it ourselves. And while we’re at it, we’ll make that 'smart’ overview available on your mobile phone, so you’re always in the loop, anywhere, anytime.

Design and development started in the beginning of 2008. A complete city calendar with a special twist: a social network feature that makes the best events come forward based on your interests and 'tips’ of your friends. Many months of development later, we had the first edition of the website and mobile applications.

That’s where we are now. As said, Tipspot is a social platform. It works best when you bring some friends — or make new ones on the website. It’s improving every day and your feedback is greatly appreciated. So let’s go! Your friends are waiting inside…

It was always about their kids, their significant others, careers, PTA meetings, soccer practices, and everything else life threw their way. For some women, it was about sacrificing all of those things in order to advance their careers and get ahead in the world. SOM is a school administration system for secondary education (Dutch high schools) in the Netherlands. The application registers grades, attendance, billing, education and final exams.

A fine-grained authorization implementation ensures that only the people that need particular information can see it. For example teachers will only be able to see the students they teach, guidance counselors will only be able to see the students they guide and administrative users will only see the administration parts, not the (private) guidance documents.

SOM has been in production since 2006 and was one of the first Apache Wicket applications put into production by Topicus. It currently serves over 5000 concurrent users and reaches 30000 requests per minute daily.

Development of SOM (then named Vocus) started with Wicket 1.0 and has followed all major released ever since. It has inspired many features of Wicket, for example the request logger, the render strategies, the SWARM and WASP security framework and many more. Without SOM, Wicket would not be where it currently stands.
